data.name: Mualim
data.gender_notes: Mualim is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who guides or teaches others, a mentor or instructor. The name Mualim carries the meaning “Guide, Teacher” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mualim usually hope their child will grow to embody guide, teacher and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, a Mualim is a spiritual guide or leader.
data.etymology: Mualim belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guide, Teacher.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mualim total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: معلم
in_arabic.meaning: معلم تعلیم و تربیت کے معنی میں
in_arabic.long_meaning: معلم علم اور حکمت کا ایک مصداق ہے، جو اسلامی تعلیم و تربیت میں اہم کردار ادا کرتا ہے۔ اس نام کی اصلیت عربی زبان میں ہے، جہاں 'علم' (ع ل م) جڑ سے بنا ہے، جس کے معنی سیکھنے، تعلیم دینے اور سمجھنے کے ہیں۔ قرآن مجید میں بھی 'علم' کے حوالے سے کئی آیات موجود ہیں، جو علم اور تعلیم کی اہمیت پر زور دیتی ہیں۔

in_urdu.name: معلم
in_urdu.meaning: تعلیم و تربیت کا ایک اہم جزو
in_urdu.long_meaning: معلم نام علم اور تعلیم کے میدان میں ایک نمایاں مقام رکھتا ہے۔ یہ نام عربی زبان کی 'علم' (ع ل م) جڑ سے ماخوذ ہے، جو سیکھنے، سکھانے اور سمجھنے کے عمل سے وابستہ ہے۔ اسلامی دنیا میں تعلیم و تربیت کو جو اہمیت حاصل ہے، اسی وجہ سے 'معلم' نام بھی اہل ایمان کے لیے ایک مقدس اور معزز نام کے طور پر شمار ہوتا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کی روایات میں بھی یہ نام احترام کے ساتھ منسلک ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मुअलिम
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुअलिम नाम का अर्थ शिक्षा और ज्ञान प्रदान करने वाला होता है। यह नाम अरबी भाषा के 'अलम' (ع ل م) मूल से निकला है, जिसका संबंध सीखने, सिखाने और समझने की क्रिया से है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, शिक्षा और ज्ञान को बहुत महत्व दिया जाता है, और इस नाम को इसी संदर्भ में महत्व दिया जाता है। यह नाम न केवल एक शिक्षक के रूप में, बल्कि एक मार्गदर्शक के रूप में भी देखा जाता है जो अपने आसपास के लोगों को ज्ञान और समझ प्रदान करता है।

in_pashto.name: معلم
in_pashto.meaning: د پوهې او زده کړې استاد
in_pashto.long_meaning: معلم نوم د پوهې او زده کړې د استاد په توګه دی. دا نوم د عربی ژبې د 'علم' (ع ل م) ريښې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې د زده کړې، ښوونې او پوهې د ترلاسه کولو معنی لري. د پښتنو او افغانانو په دودیزو کړو کې، د پوهې او زده کړې ارزښت ډیر لوړ دی، او دا نوم د هغو کسانو لپاره کارول کېږي چې د نورو ته د پوهې او حکمت په ورکولو کې مهم رول لوبوي.

in_english.name: Mualim
in_english.long_meaning: The name Mualim originates from the Arabic root 'ilm' (ع ل م), which signifies knowledge, learning, and education. In Islamic tradition, Mualim refers to a teacher, educator, or a learned person who imparts knowledge and wisdom to others. This name holds significant importance in Islamic history and culture, as education is highly valued in Islam. The Quran also emphasizes the pursuit of knowledge, making Mualim a meaningful and respected name among Muslims worldwide.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Mualim" holds great significance in many Islamic cultures as it is often associated with scholars, teachers, and religious leaders. These individuals play an essential role in transmitting knowledge and values from one generation to the next, ensuring the continuation of Islamic traditions and the spiritual development of the community. Often, a "Mualim" is revered and highly respected within their social circles, reflecting the importance of knowledge and education in Islamic societies.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Mualim" serves as a reminder of the role of the teacher and the student in seeking knowledge and following the path of spiritual growth. As discussed in many Islamic texts, knowledge is a critical component of the faith, and seeking it is an ongoing journey. The title "Mualim" highlights the essential nature of the teacher-student relationship and emphasizes the importance of being a guide and mentor to others, helping them navigate the complexities of life and deepen their understanding of the divine. Thus, the name "Mualim" represents not only the outer act of teaching but also the inner experience of spiritual development and the pursuit of knowledge and wisdom.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Guide, Teacher" symbolizes One who guides or teaches others, a mentor or instructor.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Mualim serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of guide, teacher.
